subjects: Pujan, an engineer working at a desk with paper documents, notebooks and sticky notes
one identical reusable modular block drawn the same way everywhere it appears, shown on a conveyor, being assembled, and finished at a smaller scale
a small round companion character drawn in flat shapes that carries one document or one block at a time
hand-drawn arrows, halos, squiggles and speech bubbles that show a messy pile becoming an ordered flow
composition: main subjects remain visible and unobstructed
flat hand-drawn shapes on a warm cream field, not photographic renders
reserve quiet cream negative space for the title and subtitle panel
wide assets keep the subject inside a centre crop that survives a narrow column
square and portrait assets explain a different part of the story than the hero
text_policy: narrative raster assets carry one short title plus one short subtitle; icons, SVGs, logos, and tiny helper graphics remain text-free

hero phone.purpose: hero variant for screens 640 pixels wide or narrower

motion.purpose: short looping GIF; not a narrative still, so it is exempt from the still-image provenance fields

reject_when: the main subject is covered or pushed out of the centre crop
a second competing focal point splits attention
the title or subtitle is missing, garbled, crowded or misspelled
the image carries more copy than the declared title and subtitle
the human and the tooling relationship is ambiguous
the asset fails its declared orientation or crop role
the image implies a product capability the repositories do not support
the palette drifts to neon contrast or a dense fake interface
the result is photographic, 3D-rendered or glossy instead of flat hand-drawn shapes
